oapp_uvod: Zelenko – Gorski kotar Guide is an offline guide to Gorski kotar. It works without signal, with no sign-up and no ads. Made by Marko Franković from Fužine.
oapp_izvori_popis: Map, path network, most places, services and cycling routes. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL licence.
Coordinates of some places. CC0 licence.
Photos of places and dishes. The author and licence are shown with every photo.
Opening hours, tickets and contacts from the websites of tourist boards, parks and museums. The source and date checked are shown for every place. The texts are our own.
Terrain model for route ascent and elevation profiles. © DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA.
oapp_privatnost_tekst: No account and no sign-up. Your places, stamps, saved car and settings are stored only on your phone.
Your location is used only on the phone (map, navigation, stamps) and is never sent anywhere.
For the forecast, approximate coordinates (to about 100 m) are sent to Open-Meteo, with no information about you.
If anonymous visit counting (GoatCounter) is switched on, it records only which parts of the app are opened – no cookies and no personal data.
Links to outside websites and apps (calls, email, navigation) open only when you tap them.
oapp_odgovornost_tekst: Information is checked regularly, but trails, opening hours and prices can change. On the trail, follow the signs and judge conditions yourself. The app does not guarantee that trails are passable. In an emergency, call 112.
oapp_kontakt_tekst: Found a mistake, have a suggestion or want your place in the app? Get in touch.
profil_aria: Elevation profile: ascent {uspon} m, descent {spust} m, from {min} to {max} m above sea level
procjena_rute_dem: Length is measured along OpenStreetMap paths, ascent and profile from the Copernicus terrain model. Time is an estimate.
zima_provjeri: Ski areas and sledding hills open only when there's snow. Check opening times on their website or by phone before you go.
zima_cesta: From 15 November to 15 April, winter equipment is compulsory on main roads: winter tyres (M+S) or summer tyres with at least 4 mm tread, with snow chains in the car. On other roads it applies when they are covered in snow or ice. Set off early – it gets dark fast in winter.
prijevod_napomena: Some descriptions are not translated yet and are shown in Croatian.
